name: Polar / extra-territorial — needs rollup
blurb: Regional rollup for Polar / extra-territorial aggregating 10 country needs profiles into a 15-category satisfaction vector.
mechanism: Aggregates 10 country needs profiles for Polar / extra-territorial into a region-level satisfaction vector across all 15 categories. The aggregation is a population-weighted mean (weights from the country's reported population). This sits between the per-country rollups and the global 10B model in the dependency graph.

components.name: Country ranker
components.role: Ranks countries within the region by category satisfaction.
